scripts.start: cd app && bun run build && bun run preview
scripts.dev:api: [ -d app/dist/client ] || bun run build; cd worker && bun run dev
scripts.typecheck: cd worker && bun run typecheck && cd ../app && bun run typecheck
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.deploy:staging: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging bun run build && cd app && bunx wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:production: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=production bun run build && cd app && bunx wrangler deploy
scripts.db:migrate:staging: cd worker && bunx wrangler d1 migrations apply studioos-staging-db --remote --env staging
scripts.db:migrate:production: cd worker && bunx wrangler d1 migrations apply studioos-production-db --remote --env production
